tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Window background behind every island. The toolbar, rail and status bar sit directly on it. Text on it is text or text-muted.

tokens.name: island
tokens.usage: Surface of every panel: sidebar, main view, split panes and dialogs. Default ground for text, text-muted and accent-text.

tokens.name: island-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, stat cards and the scope switcher placed on an island. text and text-muted both pass on it.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, tabs and icon buttons. text and text-muted pass on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between toolbar groups, columns and rows on an island. Decorative only: never the sole edge of an input.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edge of text inputs, checkboxes and the divider grip. At least 3:1 on island and island-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on window, island, island-raised, hover and selection.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, counts, column headers and hints on window, island, island-raised and hover. 4.5:1 or more on each.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Marks only: active tab underline, active rail icon, active pane outline and progress bars. 3:1 or more on island.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and ghost-button text on island, island-raised, hover and selection. 4.5:1 or more on each.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary button on a screen and of the logo tile. Text on it is on-primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary. 5:1.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Background of the selected tree row, the selected commit row and an active toggle. The label keeps text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus outline. 3:1 or more on window, island and island-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: The cloned-locally dot and the synced dot. A mark, 3:1 on island. Always beside a word or a title.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Text such as Cloned or Connected as, on island and on success-bg.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Pill and notice background behind success-text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Deleted line counts (shown with a minus sign) and destructive text on island.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Text for Partial, Unavailable and certificate warnings on island and on warning-bg.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background behind warning-text.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral tile such as the all-repositories scope icon and the pane 2 marker. Text on it is text.

tokens.name: host-github
tokens.usage: Tile behind the GH label. The label is text.

tokens.name: host-gitlab
tokens.usage: Tile behind the GL label. The label is text.

tokens.name: host-selfhosted
tokens.usage: Tile behind the SH label for self-hosted GitLab and GitHub Enterprise. The label is text.

tokens.name: lane-1
tokens.usage: Graph lane 1, the main line, and HEAD ring. Mark, 3:1 on island.

tokens.name: lane-2
tokens.usage: Graph lane 2.

tokens.name: lane-3
tokens.usage: Graph lane 3.

tokens.name: lane-4
tokens.usage: Graph lane 4.

tokens.name: lane-5
tokens.usage: Graph lane 5.

tokens.name: lane-6
tokens.usage: Graph lane 6. Lanes repeat after six.

tokens.name: ref-head-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the HEAD badge. Text on it is ref-head-fg.

tokens.name: ref-head-fg
tokens.usage: Text on ref-head-bg.

tokens.name: ref-main-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the branch and remote badges on ref-main-bg or island.

tokens.name: ref-main-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the branch badge.

tokens.name: ref-main-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the branch badge.

tokens.name: ref-feature-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the feature-branch badge on ref-feature-bg.

tokens.name: ref-feature-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the feature-branch badge.

tokens.name: ref-feature-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the feature-branch badge.

tokens.name: ref-project-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the remote project-branch badge on ref-project-bg.

tokens.name: ref-project-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the project-branch badge.

tokens.name: ref-project-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the project-branch badge.

tokens.name: ref-tag-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the tag badge on ref-tag-bg. The badge also carries a tag icon.

tokens.name: ref-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the tag badge.

tokens.name: ref-tag-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of the tag badge.

tokens.name: proj-blue
tokens.usage: Project color 1. Glyph color and, at 20%, the tile behind a project icon.

tokens.name: proj-teal
tokens.usage: Project color 2.

tokens.name: proj-violet
tokens.usage: Project color 3.

tokens.name: proj-amber
tokens.usage: Project color 4.

tokens.name: proj-rose
tokens.usage: Project color 5.

tokens.name: proj-green
tokens.usage: Project color 6.

tokens.name: proj-pink
tokens.usage: Project color 7.

tokens.name: proj-gray
tokens.usage: Project color 8.

tokens.name: avatar-1
tokens.usage: Avatar tone 1. Initials are avatar-ink.

tokens.name: avatar-2
tokens.usage: Avatar tone 2.

tokens.name: avatar-3
tokens.usage: Avatar tone 3.

tokens.name: avatar-4
tokens.usage: Avatar tone 4.

tokens.name: avatar-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on every avatar tone.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Project name on the project overview.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Repository name in the repo header.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Pane repo name, commit subject in the detail panel, section headings.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default interface text: rows, buttons, inputs.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Field labels, selected rows, repo names in tables.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary text, counts, column headers, hints.

styles.name: hash
styles.usage: Commit hashes, paths and file names.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between islands and between islands and the window edge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar items and between buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of rows and table cells.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding inside an island.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of dialogs and the project overview.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Ref badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Host badges and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tree rows, icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Rail buttons, project icon tiles, icon grid buttons.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Islands and stat cards.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Avatars, pane markers and status dots.

shadow.note: Islands are separated by the window color and a 6px gap, not by shadow. Shadows are for floating layers only.

tokens.name: shadow-island
tokens.usage: Resting island. None in dark; a hairline lift in light so white islands read against the grey window.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, popovers and the project icon picker.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs over the scrim.

size.note: Fixed dimensions of the application shell.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Top toolbar on the window.

tokens.name: titlebar-inset
tokens.usage: Left space in the toolbar for the macOS traffic lights.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Icon rail left of the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Sidebar island.

tokens.name: tree-row-height
tokens.usage: Rows in the repository tree.

tokens.name: graph-row-height
tokens.usage: Rows in the commit graph.

tokens.name: graph-lane-width
tokens.usage: Horizontal distance between graph lanes.

tokens.name: pane-min-width
tokens.usage: Smallest width of a split pane before the panes stack.

tokens.name: divider-width
tokens.usage: Draggable divider between split panes.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Default icon size.

tokens.name: icon-size-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons, rows and badges.
